messages:
liam (Support): Heads up — welcome emails failing for new tenants in eu-west-1. Two trials stuck (Solstice, CedarPay) after signup. Escalating to CS for outreach and a comms plan.

maya (CS): Ack. Is this causing users to be blocked from activating?

liam (Support): Yes — users never get the verification link, so activation flow halts. Logs show repeated SMTP 550 errors (relay denied). Happened after the last SMTP config rollout at ~09:10 UTC.

ops-bot: Ticket created INFR-3245 linking logs + recent deploy diff.

nate (CS Manager): Maya — can you own customer touch? Olivia, please prep AE outreach for renewal-sensitive customers.

maya (CS): I can own. Quick questions: do we have a safe manual activation path if emails can't be retried?

liam (Support): Support can manually flip activation to true for affected accounts as stopgap; need CS to confirm list and get permission from customers.

olivia (AE): I'll message Solstice and CedarPay after Maya drafts the note. If this impacts onboarding KPIs we should consider an offer.

maya (CS): Draft customer note below — feel free to edit: 

-----
Hi <Name>,
We noticed your welcome email didn't arrive due to an email delivery issue on our side. We can:
1) Manually activate your account so you can start using the product immediately, or
2) Retry sending the verification email once our fix is in place.
Please reply with which you prefer and we'll take care of it right away. Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing a fix.
Best,
Maya, Customer Success (Redwood)
-----

maya (CS): If they pick manual activation, we should also run a quick health-check and a 1:1 onboarding session offer.

olivia (AE): Agreed. I'll offer a short onboarding call and suggest a one-month credit for the inconvenience if they accept.

sara (Enablement): Temporary workaround documented: set admin flag allow_unverified_smtp=true and requeue welcome emails. Command we used in staging: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/admin/requeue-welcome" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT_ID>"}'
```

This unblocks delivery attempts without changing SMTP provider config. Ops will need to monitor bounce rate.

liam (Support): We'll test the workaround on a dev tenant now. If green, we can apply to affected tenants in small batches.

ops-bot: INFR-3245 updated: workaround flagged as "approved for emergency use".

nate (CS Manager): Comms plan for internal stakeholders:
- Maya: send customer note to affected accounts within 30 minutes.
- Olivia: follow up with AE outreach and renewal sensitivity flags.
- Support: apply manual activation only after customer consents.
- Ops: deploy temp workaround, monitor bounce/latency, revert post-fix.

maya (CS): I'll send notes now. Posting the exact messages I send here for visibility.

liam (Support): Wanted to call out risk to renewal signals — if activation is delayed >72 hours, flag for renewal team.

olivia (AE): Noted. I'll add a renewal risk tag and schedule a proactive check-in for any trial that misses 48h activation.

maya (CS): Update: sent Solstice & CedarPay messages. Solstice replied: prefers manual activation + onboarding call. CedarPay requested retry email.

liam (Support): Applied manual activation for Solstice after consent and queued onboarding session. CedarPay queued for retry; re-send attempt scheduled now.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert created: email-bounce-rate-eu-west-1 > 0.8% — paging channel eng-email if not resolved in 15m.

sara (Enablement): I updated the playbook with the workaround steps and suggested AE credit guideline. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/cs/playbooks/email-activation-failures

nate (CS Manager): Great work. Keep posting updates in this thread. After we stabilize, we'll run a retro and update onboarding SLAs. :thumbsup:

maya (CS): Will do. Closing loop here in 2 hours with status and next steps.
